labels.0: No glaucoma named for this eye
labels.1: Glaucoma named in the eye's diagnostic keywords

output.meaning: sigmoid score for glaucoma present, in [0, 1]

threshold_source: selected on the patient-separated validation split: highest threshold with sensitivity >= 85%; the test split was not used for any choice
architecture: MobileNetV2 (ImageNet weights) -> GlobalAveragePooling2D -> Dropout(0.3) -> Dense(64, relu) -> Dropout(0.2) -> Dense(1, sigmoid); head trained with Adam 1e-4, then top 30 backbone layers fine-tuned at 1e-5 (BatchNorm frozen); class weights; early stopping on validation loss; SEED 42

training.dataset: Kaggle andrewmvd/ocular-disease-recognition-odir5k (ODIR-5K training set, per-eye diagnostic keywords)
training.label_rule: positive if 'glaucoma' appears in that eye's keywords; excluded: ['suspected glaucoma', 'optic disk photographically invisible'] and unusable photos ['low image quality', 'image offset', 'no fundus image', 'anterior segment image']
training.split: by patient, 70/15/15, stratified on whether a patient has glaucoma and/or cataract; no patient in more than one split
training.export: float32 TFLite; max |Keras - TFLite| score difference on validation 5.07e-06

metrics.source: notebooks/odir_glaucoma_cataract.ipynb (test split scored once with the exported TFLite file)

metrics_status: measured on a patient-separated held-out test split (1040 eyes, 42 positive, 524 patients); limited evidence, not clinically validated; below the 85% sensitivity / 80% specificity targets
limitations: Screening support only. Not a diagnosis and not clinically validated.
Binary result only: ODIR-5K has no severity grades, so no severity band is given.
Labels come from free-text diagnostic keywords per eye in ODIR-5K and may be noisy.
Small positive class: 42 positive test eyes, so the intervals are wide.
Single public dataset collected in one country; no external validation; no smartphone-lens images.
